raw_site_text: 51 rural locations of the provinces of Maputo Province, Gaza, and Inhambane in southern Mozambique
justification: The 102 enumeration areas were sampled from Maputo Province (northern districts bordering Gaza), Gaza, and Inhambane.
note: Maputo Province is also a study province but has no entry in admissible_units (list has no Maputo), so only Gaza and Inhambane could be matched. Patched 2026-10-20 after supplementary WB units were added: Maputo Province -> 'Maputo' (WB GAULx).
